information: This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about)! **Please check out the Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab to learn more about the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast and what you can do to support the mission.** ​ ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc5MDYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--55d04463db7d97e68854ce1ad4ffb960c1ed23fd/SOUTHEAST_5.png) This competition is made possible with partnersips with [CubingUSA](https://www.cubingusa.org) and Vanderbilt Cube Club. Please make sure to read the **[Venue, Travel, and Lunch](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VanderbiltSpring2024#37497-venue-travel-and-lunch)** tab for information about parking and food. ## MINORS POLICY: A parent or guardian MUST be present at check-in for anyone under the age of 18 who plans to compete. Vanderbilt University requires all minors (persons under the age of 18) attending this competition to be accompanied by a parent or guardian. All participants under the age of 18 must fill out the form linked below: # https://forms.gle/cFt7i8vmK9yEA7U2A **We reserve the right to deny entry into the venue if you have not filled out the form.**
